verdictMeaning: A student who joins rolls one die in the lobby and the number becomes their family: one parent for 1-3, two for 4-6, the rest children, with ages that make sense and hidden strength, health and housework that differ on average by sex and overlap between people. The hidden stats reach no client. A child under ten cannot be sent anywhere. A family that joined and never rolled is rolled for at Start. Registered as FIC-GONZ-021. Proved headless, by injected regression, and live in a browser.
ownerDirection: 2026-09-12, quoted in docs/FAMILY_CREATION.md section 1, with four answers: the roll is the family size; hidden and very likely fatal; average by sex and dealt per person; parents and children 16+ may fight.
defaultsChosenWithoutAsking: A lone parent is a man or a woman with equal chance.
The principal is the father when there is one, otherwise the lone parent.
A child under ten cannot be given work, sent on a road or asked a call.
Rolling is refused once anything is in the family's record besides its founding.
Households nobody joined keep the founding two parents and two children.

liveBrowserProof.server: PORT=1847 TEXAS_DATA_DIR=<scratch> SEED=dice PLAYERS=5 TICK_MS=400 node server/main.mjs - an isolated class
observed: After joining: the 'Roll for your family' panel was shown, the walk-through was held back, the family book said 'Roll the die to find out who your family is.' and listed nobody.

The person card for the founding principal was open behind the dice with work controls. That would have let a student spend the roll by setting work first, so the card is now hidden until the family is rolled; after the fix it was hidden.
Activating 'Roll the die': 'Rolling...' with the die tumbling, then 'You rolled a 5.' and 'Meet your family'.

'Meet your family' opened the journal: 'father, 39 | Trinidad | Married to Dorotea. Father to Mateo and Marcela and Soledad.', 'mother, 32 | Dorotea', 'son, 14 | Mateo', 'daughter, 4 | Marcela', 'daughter, 0 | Soledad'. Members hh-1-parent-1 ... hh-1-child-3. The record reads 'Your family rolled a 5.'
The student's snapshot and /api/family together contained no 'traits', 'strength' or 'housework'.
liveBrowserProof.polish: A newborn is now labelled 'under a year' rather than '0'.
